cases.name: laps_off
cases.src:
Lp = Laps(["load", "math", "store"], wgsize=128, keep="last", records=8, on=False)
kn = b.entry(Args(**Lp.args()), wgsize=128)
run = Lp.begin(b, kn)
acc = V.u32(kn.tid * 3, name="acc")
for step in ("store", "load", "math"):
    run.lap(step)
run.record()
run.lap("math")
run.end()

cases.name: slots_put_dword
cases.src:
Gw = xwg.Gens(name="gw", per="member", words=3, wgsize=64)
Box = xwg.Slots(name="box", slots=3, pieces=32, piece=16, tag="dword", wgsize=64)
kn = b.entry(Args(**Gw.args(), **Box.args()), wgsize=64)
gen = Gw.begin(b, kn, at=kn.wgid)
box = Box.begin(b, kn, gen)
pc = box.piece()
pc[0] = kn.tid
pc[1] = 9
pc[2] = kn.wgid
box.put(2, kn.tid >> 1, pc)

Cn = xwg.Counts(name="tally", wgsize=128)
total = S.u32(6, name="total")

gone = ct.leave(1, total)

cases.name: tag_first_made_in_an_arm
cases.src:
Gw = xwg.Gens(name="gw", per="party", words=2, wgsize=64)
kn = b.entry(Args(**Gw.args()), wgsize=64)
gen = Gw.begin(b, kn, at=1)
sel = S.u32(name="sel", at=24)
with b.when(sel != 0):
    inner = S.u32(gen.tag(ahead=1) ^ 5, name="inner")
outer = S.u32(gen.tag(ahead=1) + 3, name="outer")
with b.when(sel == 7):
    again = S.u32(gen.tag(ahead=1) - 1, name="again")

cases.name: tag_first_made_in_a_lane_region
cases.src:
Gw = xwg.Gens(name="gw", per="member", words=2, wgsize=64)
kn = b.entry(Args(**Gw.args()), wgsize=64)
gen = Gw.begin(b, kn, at=kn.wgid)
with b.lanes(kn.lane < 5):
    inside = V.u32(gen.tag_bits(4, 8) | kn.tid, name="inside")
after = V.u32(gen.tag_bits(4, 8) + kn.tid, name="after")
with b.lanes(kn.lane > 9):
    reused = V.u32(gen.tag_bits(4, 8) - kn.tid, name="reused")
